scope: Dense finite-pool actual-column swap oracle, not a selection method or production timing result

protocol.candidates: union of 24 uniform unused indices and 8 largest absolute true residual unused indices
protocol.removals: every existing landmark; exact k unique actual kernel columns retained
protocol.ranking: independently evaluated A-energy error against dense direct solution
protocol.final_branches: union of top five swaps at each horizon; independent rebuilt-state continuation with preserved history and with cleared history
protocol.recurrence: FCG1 with two-pass A orthogonalization and one normalized p/Ap pair
protocol.checkpoint_residual: all branches inherit identical recursive residual; pool uses separately checked true residual
protocol.relative_eigenvalues: exact rank-two Gram for Mnew relative to Mold; identity eigenvalues included
protocol.memory_note: dense A, dense reference solve, batched trajectories, and all candidate records are oracle-only allocations
